standardPanelHardware.derivationRule: If an exact-model orthographic-front real image cannot be acquired, use the best exact-model real product image and rectify/crop it into a front-facing runtime visual. Do not use isometric/perspective source as-is.
mandatoryGates: exact-model identity or exact article provenance
source image must show enough of the real product front/body to support rectification
derived runtime asset must be front-facing with side/top depth visually removed or minimized
original source and derived asset provenance must both be recorded
physical envelope must come from exact technical dimensions or an explicitly approved class-reference
terminal geometry must remain independently verified; image rectification does not verify terminal centers
